##### Project general facts

Manazel Al Khor is an exclusive residential development in the heart of Culture Village, offering 76 spacious 3- and 4-bedroom apartments that combine modern Arabian architecture with a refined cultural setting. Designed as a true monument to modern luxury living, the residences feature distinctive architecture and thoughtfully planned layouts, with each home offering its own unique views. Spacious interiors, natural light, and excellent air distribution create a peaceful and comfortable living environment.

The development is designed as a mixed-use project with a range of supporting amenities for residents. Facilities include swimming pools, a gymnasium, basement parking, and retail spaces, providing convenience and leisure within the development. Its thoughtfully planned setting brings together residential comfort and everyday amenities while preserving the calm and character of Culture Village.

The residences feature spacious interiors with high-quality finishes and carefully planned layouts that enhance comfort and functionality. Each apartment comes with an equipped kitchen and is fully furnished, creating a complete and elegant living environment ready to move in.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai’s culture dates back to the mid 19th century when the Creek, the city’s most distinct identity and veritable lifeline, flourished as a maritime centre of commerce, pearling and fishing, bringing along its own charming heritage and civilization. While Dubai has evolved since then, rising to emerge as the fastest growing city in the region, the nostalgia of a bygone era has continued to persist. Today, the original small settlement along the 14-km long waterway has developed beyond imagination, attracting people from across the globe and turning into a thriving cosmopolitan community.

Culture Village seeks to rejuvenate the romance and mystique of a civilisation that flourished by the creek. Built on a staggering 40-million square feet plot of land, Culture Village will be Dubai’s first creek-side mixed-use master development offering a multitude of residential, commercial, retail, entertainment and cultural districts, all within a single destination. Culture Village will also feature an innovative art centre developed by Art Jameel, one of Abdul Latif Jameel Community Initiatives. This art centre will be a venue for the Jameel Art Collection and the Jameel Prize. The centre will aim to support local and regional creative businesses and provide a platform for creative ideas and encounters.

Right in the heart of the city just minutes from Dubai International Airport, alongside the charming Dubai Creek and its surrounding old-world neighborhoods, Culture Village enjoys a location like no other. The surrounding environment is reflective of the old-world charm that encompasses this symbol of traditional modernity. Manazel Al Khor Residence is ideally placed within walking distance from the Versace Hotel, the D1 Tower and many more exquisite venues. What makes living in Manazel Al Khor even more pleasing and convenient is the direct access to major arterial bridges and close proximity to metro and water taxi stations.
